title: POST /api/tasks hangs before responding
summary: app/api/tasks/route.ts awaits a promise that never resolves before creating or returning the task, so POST never answers and the UI never refetches. The "creating a task..." test times out at toContainText on the task list (this scenario is expected to be slow: 5s expect timeouts).

expectedFailure.testTitle: creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter
